name: K&B Outreach — 2. Inbound Listener & Opt-Out Guard

nodes.name: IMAP: New Mail
nodes.notes: Primary trigger. Marks mail as read so a message is processed once.

nodes.name: Webhook: Inbound Email
nodes.notes: Alternative trigger: point Postmark/SendGrid inbound parsing here. Disable the IMAP node if you use this.

nodes.name: W2 Config
nodes.notes: Reads env vars and passes the inbound message through with cfg attached.

nodes.name: Normalize Inbound
nodes.notes: One shape from either trigger: IMAP item or Postmark inbound webhook body.

nodes.name: Classify Reply
nodes.notes: bounce / auto-reply / opt-out / replied. Quoted history is stripped first.

nodes.name: Loop Over Replies
nodes.notes: One reply at a time. An IMAP poll can deliver several at once, and each needs its own Airtable lookup — batching them would cross the wires.

nodes.name: Actionable?
nodes.notes: Out-of-office autoresponders stop here — they must never be treated as replies.

nodes.name: Find Lead in Airtable
nodes.notes: Matches on the stored Message ID (In-Reply-To/References) first, then the sender address.

nodes.name: Resolve Match & Decide
nodes.notes: Status precedence: Do Not Contact > Replied > everything else. An opt-out is never downgraded.

nodes.name: Update Lead Status
nodes.notes: Writes Replied / Do Not Contact / Invalid. Workflow 1 then ignores the record forever.

nodes.name: Slack: Reply Alert
nodes.notes: Fires the moment a human replies — the whole point of the campaign.

nodes.name: Twilio: SMS Alert
nodes.notes: Optional. Basic auth: username = Account SID, password = Auth Token.

nodes.name: Slack: Unmatched Reply
nodes.notes: A reply we could not match to a lead is a data problem worth a human look.

nodes.name: No Change Needed
nodes.notes: Already Do Not Contact, or already Replied.

parameters.content:
## Workflow 2 — Inbound Listener & Opt-Out Guard

Every inbound message is triaged into one of four verdicts **before** anything is written:

| verdict | trigger | Airtable |
|---|---|---|
| `bounce` | DSN headers / mailer-daemon | `Status = Invalid` |
| `auto` | out-of-office, `Auto-Submitted` | **nothing** — sequence continues |
| `optout` | stop / unsubscribe / not interested / remove / wrong person | `Status = Do Not Contact` |
| `replied` | anything else a human typed | `Status = Replied` + Slack/SMS |

Opt-out matching runs on the **stripped** reply only. Our own signature says *reply "stop"* — matching the raw body would opt out every single person who answers.

### Safety guarantee
`Replied` and `Do Not Contact` are terminal. Workflow 1 excludes them in its Airtable formula **and** re-checks each record immediately before sending. An opt-out is never downgraded back to `Replied`, whatever arrives later.
